ROOTED IN CRAFT. MADE FOR EVERYDAY.

Bamboo shop in Shidlaghatta, Karnataka

Visit Sri Balaji Bamboo Works on Garden Road, Shidlaghatta, Chikkaballapur district. Explore handwoven baskets, traditional Mara trays, hand fans, bamboo poles and ladders, with English and Kannada product names. Confirm sizes, availability and delivery with our workshop before payment.
